user.title: Inverter communication type
user.description: Choose the integration that exposes the inverter to Home Assistant. Existing entries remain compatible with ESPHome Deye Inverter — Lewa-Reka.

mapping_mode.title: Mapping method
mapping_mode.description: Automatic discovery only suggests entities. Every selection is shown before final confirmation.

inverter_device.title: Select the Home Assistant inverter device
inverter_device.description: Automatic mapping will use only entities assigned to this device, preventing entities from another inverter or an old integration from being mixed in.

inverter.title: 1 of 5 — Deye inverter and energy flows
inverter.description: Select the available control and measurement entities. Every field may be left empty; a missing entity limits its capability but does not block saving after final confirmation.

data_description.work_mode_select: Select entity used to choose provider work modes such as Zero Export To Load or Selling First.
data_description.grid_power_sensor: Configure the import/export sign later in the Tariff and distribution tab.
data_description.battery_power_sensor: Configure the charge/discharge sign later in the Tariff and distribution tab.

provider_options.title: Custom control values
provider_options.description: Enter the exact option values exposed by the selected entities. Control commands are never guessed.

tou_1_3.title: Deye Time Of Use mapping — ranges 1–3
tou_1_3.description: Map start, SOC and charging source for ranges 1–3. The integration never turns the main Time Of Use control on or off.

tou_4_6.title: Deye Time Of Use mapping — ranges 4–6
tou_4_6.description: Map the remaining physical TOU ranges.

energy_details.title: Optional Deye detail entities
energy_details.description: Every field is optional. LOAD phases improve history and fallback; energy counters improve settlement.

prices.title: 2 of 5 — Energy price entities
prices.description: Map price entities only. Configure the DSO, tariff and power-flow signs in the card's Tariff and distribution tab.

solcast.title: 3 of 5 — Solcast PV forecast
solcast.description: Select Solcast entities. Accuracy is calculated only after a day is complete.

weather.title: 4 of 5 — Local weather forecast
weather.description: Weather is an auxiliary risk signal and does not replace Solcast.

data_description.weather_entity: Default suggestion: weather.forecast_home_2. You may select any weather.* entity that provides an hourly forecast.

capabilities.title: 5 of 6 — Read-only capability test
capabilities.description: Device: {device}. Readings: {readings}. Basic control: {basic_control}. Selling: {selling}. Charging: {charging}. Full TOU: {full_tou}. Core/AI: {core_ai}.

inverter_power.title: 6 of 6 — Inverter maximum AC power
inverter_power.description: Detected sell-power entity limit: {detected} W. Set the sell-power ceiling in watts (1–{absolute} W). Default: {default} W.

summary.title: Test and confirm
summary.description: Total fields: {total}. Mapped: {mapped}. Skipped: {skipped}. Available capabilities: {capabilities}. Missing full-control fields: {missing}. Missing provider/TOU fields: {provider_missing}. Entities from another device: {device_issues}. A partial mapping can be saved after explicit confirmation.

error.required_entity_missing: A full-control entity is missing or unavailable.
error.provider_entity_missing: A provider entity or explicit option is missing; the related capability remains unavailable.
error.entity_from_other_device: At least one selected entity belongs to another Home Assistant device. Correct the mapping to avoid controlling the wrong inverter.
error.invalid_inverter_max_power_w: Power must be between 1000 and 30000 W.
error.mapped_entity_missing: The mapped price entity is missing. DEM will not substitute another entity.
error.unsupported_price_schema: The selected entity does not publish a supported price series. Configure an explicit custom mapping.

abort.already_configured: Deye Energy Manager is already configured.
